description: KMA API Hub (기상청 API허브) is a data repository run by Korea Meteorological Administration. The API hub provides programme access to the observation, radar, satellite, numerical model, typhoon and earthquake products of the administration with an authorization key. Coverage: South Korea and surroundings. It is reached online through the home page and its search, download or service pages, in forms such as api; access is free of charge with an authorization key. The licence is: terms set by the site, not read in this search. Caveats: the home page was opened on 2026-09-30 and only its title ("기상청 API허브") was read, so the holdings, the current terms and the availability of downloads were not browsed, and this description rests on the agency's publicly documented role and may lag the site. It can support real-time weather and hazard feeds for Korean infrastructure operation studies. Related records: no directly related record is catalogued yet.
